skip_when: the task cannot affect rendered pixels
the only unresolved question requires semantic object recognition

stages.purpose: Characterize an unknown artifact before choosing a diagnosis.
stages.skip_when: A numerical acceptance criterion or specific hypothesis is already supplied.

stages.purpose: Test one stated explanation with the smallest discriminating measurements.
requirements: State the predicted metric if the hypothesis is true.
State the result that would reject the hypothesis.
Run only queries capable of changing the next decision.

stages.purpose: Compare the post-change artifact with the baseline or acceptance criterion.
requirements: Reuse the baseline selection and parameters.
Use direct two-image comparison only when dimensions and channels are compatible.
Report pass or fail against an explicit threshold.

constraints: Use at most one grid of no more than 16 cells.
Narrow the region before increasing spatial resolution.

stop_conditions: The stated hypothesis is supported or rejected.
The acceptance criterion has passed or failed.
Two successive queries did not reduce uncertainty.
Another query would not change the next implementation decision.
The remaining uncertainty is semantic and requires visual or user context.
The default hard query limit has been reached.
prohibited_behaviors: Repeating equivalent statistics without a stated reason.
Using dense spatial grids before stating a hypothesis.
Inferring object identity from color statistics alone.
Resizing incompatible images to force a comparison.
Continuing after a stop condition without explaining the exception.
